Edge AI for Streak Advisors
AI Agent System — System Summary
May 2025
Live & deployed
What Was Built

A four-agent AI system purpose-built for Streak Advisors' grant writing and government contracting workflows. Deployed on Railway (backend) and Vercel (frontend), with agents that auto-route messages to the most relevant specialist. Connected to Google Drive, Gmail, and Google Calendar for live document access and operational workflows.

Railway · backend Vercel · frontend Google Drive Gmail Google Calendar claude-sonnet-4.5
The Four Agents
Business Assistant
Workflow coordination and task management. Messages are automatically routed to the most relevant agent.
Grant Specialist
Funder research, eligibility screens, and letter-of-intent drafting against your client briefs.
Contracting Specialist
RFP parsing, compliance matrices, and red-line summaries against your standard MSA.
Personal Agent
Scheduling, reminders, and personal correspondence — the quiet one running in the background.

To Get Started
1
Log in at edge-ai-system.vercel.app with your credentials.
2
Connect Google at the backend URL /auth/google to enable Drive, Gmail, and Calendar access.
3
Start chatting — agents route automatically based on your message content. No need to select an agent manually.
